# Quantum Solver

## Abstract
This study evaluates a multinomial logistic regression model (one-vs-rest via closed-form normal equations on polynomial features) against a majority-class baseline on the Iris dataset. Using a fixed stratified split, we assess test accuracy to determine if the executed method outperforms the baseline.
## Conclusion
The multinomial logistic regression model (one-vs-rest via closed-form normal equations on polynomial features) achieved [RESULT-1] on the Iris dataset. These results support the efficacy of the executed method compared to the majority-class baseline.
